notes.title: We now support Steam Trading Cards!
notes.notes:
Better late than never - We now support Trading Cards! That includes the whole system - cards, badges, emoticons, and profile backgrounds.

For information on how they work, you can find Steam's documentation [url=https://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards]here.[/url]

Feel free to use our Trading sub-forum for exchanging cards to complete your set.

Thanks everybody!

notes.title: Strata introduces inStudio VR
notes.notes: You can now download inStudio VR! inStudio VR allows 3D designers to import their models straight from Strata 3D CX and other design applications to a virtual reality environment. From the app, users can stage, view, and alter their models using motion controls in different settings like a kitchen, living room, or retail store. The app is free for a limited time.
